ns0:metadata.ns0:title: Evaluate to true if the oval-def:set construct is properly supported
ns0:metadata.ns0:description: This definition is intended to evaluate to true if the interpreter properly supports the oval-def:set construct and all of its valid operations.

ns0:criterion.comment: Test that the set object is supported with the filter element.

ns3:file_test.comment: Test that the set object is supported with the filter element.

ns3:file_object.comment: This object represents a file_object with a path that matches the regular expression 'C:\\support\\txt.*'.
This object represents a file_object that is the set {a,b,c} filtered by b and c which equals set {a}.

ns3:file_state.comment: This file_state represents a file_object with a path equal to 'C:\support\txt'.
This file_state represents a file_object with a path that equals 'C:\support\txt\txtfile' or 'C:\support\txt\txtfile\subtxtfile'.

ns0:constant_variable.comment: This constant_variable represents the string values 'C:\support\txt\txtfile' and 'C:\support\txt\txtfile\subtxtfile'.
